scripts.local:bootstrap: npm run local:seed && npm run local
scripts.build: cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma && next build
scripts.dev: cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db next dev
scripts.start: cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db next start
scripts.db:push:sqlite: cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma
scripts.db:seed:sqlite:admin: cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db prisma db push --schema prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma && cross-env PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite SQLITE_DATABASE_URL=file:./prisma/dev.db node prisma/seed-sqlite-admin.mjs
scripts.cf:build: cross-env NEXT_TURBO=0 PRISMA_DB_PROVIDER=sqlite prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma && opennextjs-cloudflare build
scripts.cf:d1:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply aethelperfumes --remote --config wrangler.toml
scripts.cf:d1:seed: npx wrangler d1 execute aethelperfumes --remote --config wrangler.toml --file prisma/seed_d1.sql --yes
scripts.cf:deploy: npm run cf:build && npm run cf:prepare && npm run cf:d1:migrate && npm run cf:d1:seed && npm run cf:deploy:pages
